design: Deterministic paired controller replay on identical expert-approved pre-event action traces. The neural proposal is held fixed to isolate post-transition memory, retrieval and authorization behavior.

analysis.binary_discordance: exact two-sided paired binomial test with discordant counts

claim_decision_rules.incremental_ENSR_mechanism_supported: Full ENSR must outperform ENSR-base on correctly resolved persistent obligations, show no increase in unsupported actions, and improve either terminal success or repair locality.
claim_decision_rules.package_only_claim: If full ENSR outperforms B4 but ties ENSR-base on persistent-obligation resolution, evidence supports the complete package relative to fixed sequential control but not the incremental persistence mechanism.
claim_decision_rules.mechanism_not_supported: If full ENSR ties or underperforms ENSR-base on persistent-obligation resolution, the target-domain mechanism claim is not supported.
